ciCommands.pnpm typecheck:all: It type-checks the web, backend, sdk, shared, chrome-extension, desktop and mobile packages and the e2e project, while the standard typecheck covers the web app only.
ciCommands.node scripts/compiler-check.mjs: It finds web files that the React Compiler skips without any build error, and fails on a skip that is not in the recorded baseline.
ciCommands.pnpm test:oxlint-plugin: It runs the tests for the repo's own oxlint rules, so a broken rule cannot pass lint by accident.
ciCommands.pnpm --filter @vmem/backend exec vitest: It runs the backend Vitest suite but passes the affected-tests args, so a narrowed pull-request run tests only the files the diff touches ($VV_TEST_CHANGED is --changed=origin/<base>, with --passWithNoTests so a diff that touches no backend test still passes); on main or a full-scope run the args are empty and the whole suite runs. It calls vitest through `exec` so the flags reach vitest directly: `pnpm run test -- --changed` leaks a bare `--` that vitest reads as a positional, which drops the flag and runs the whole suite.
ciCommands.pnpm --filter web exec vitest run $VV_TE: It runs the web Vitest suite but passes the affected-tests args, so a narrowed pull-request run tests only the files the diff touches ($VV_TEST_CHANGED is --changed=origin/<base>, with --passWithNoTests so a diff that touches no web test still passes); on main or a full-scope run the args are empty and the whole suite runs. It calls vitest through `exec` so the flags reach vitest directly: `pnpm run test -- --changed` leaks a bare `--` that vitest reads as a positional, which drops the flag and runs the whole suite.
